svg.aria-label: F134.8 flows in the new look: what the change reaches
svg.title: F134.8 flows in the new look: what the change reaches

g.text: F134.8 flows in the new look
a picture shown in a page
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: One layout serves the docs and the site. A flow's lines change in both. The look changes wherever the tool draws a flow. The site's pages keep their own look, and a class chart keeps everything.
